chapter.verse: A hang pen thukhun in hih thugilte ii limlemel taktak nei lo-in hong tung ding a hoih thute ii a liim ciang bek nei ahih manin Pasian a zuan mite pen tua thukhun in kum sima kiluui den biakpiaknate tawh cingtaaksak thei ngeilo hi.

Cingtaaksak thei hileh khatvei tawh a kicing dingin a kisiansuah khin ahi Pasian biate in mawhna hanga piang kisuanna lungsim nei nawnlo ding uh ahih manin biakpiakna a luuite uh zong khawl khin ding uh hilo ahi hiam?
Tu-a biakpiaknate ah ahihleh kum simin mawhna a phawkkiksak thu khat om hi.
A hang pen bawngtal sisan leh keeltal sisan tawh mawhna kilakhia theilo hi.
Hih thu hangin Khris leitung hong pai lai-in hih bangin ci hi: “Biakpiaknate leh biakpiak vante na lunggulh kei a, pumpi khat kei' ading nong koihkholhsak khinzo hi.
Meihal biakpiaknate leh mawhphel biakpiaknate tawh a lungkim na hikei hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, ‘En in, a kizial laihual sungah keima' thu a kigelh mah bangin Pasian aw, nangma' deihna a sem dingin kong pai hi,’ ka ci hi.”
Hihte a genna ah, “Nangmah in biakpiaknate, biakpiak vante, meihal biakpiaknate, mawhphel biakpiaknate na lunggulh kei a, zong na lungkim kei hi,” ci hi (hihte pen thukhun dung zui-a kiluui ahi hi).
“En in, nangma' deihna a sem dingin kong pai hi,” cihbeh lai hi. A nihna a phuh theih nadingin a khatna a hemkhia ahi hi.
Tua Pasian' deihna hangin eite pen khatvei tawh a kicing Jesu Khris' pumpi a kiluuina tawh hong kisiansuah hi.
Siampi a kici khempeuh ni simin biakpiakna phual ah ding uh a, mawhna a lakhia thei ngeilo, biakpiakna a kibang mah luui kikkik uh hi.
Ahih hangin Khris ahihleh mawhphel biakpiakna nam khat a tawntung' ading a luui khit ciangin Pasian' taklam ah tu hi.
Tua huna kipanin a galte khempeuh a vekun ama' khe-ngakna tokhom a kisuahsak ding hun ngakin om hi.
A hang pen biakpiak khatvei luuina tawh amah in siansuahna a ngah mite a bupin cingtaaksak hi.
A hang pen Kha Siangtho in zong a nuai-a bangin teci na pang hi:
“Topa in ci hi: Hih pen tua hunlenite khit ah amau tawh ka bawl ding thuciamna hi. Keima' thukhunte a lungsim sung uhah guangin a lungtang sung uhah ka gelh ding hi.”
Hih bangin zong genbeh lai hi: “Amaute a mawhna uh leh thukhun palsat-a a gamtatte uh lungsim ah ka koih nawnkei ding hi.”
Hih thute a kimaisakna mun ah mawhna hanga biakpiakna om nawnlo hi.
Tua ahih manin sanggamte aw, Jesu' sisan hangin siangtho munte ah lut theih nading sunglam kimuanna a nei khin i hih nungsang,
ama' pumpi tawh inndei puanpi khengphei-in eite' adinga hong honsak nuntakna lampi thak hangin sunglam kimuanna a nei khin i hih nungsang,
tua banah Pasian' innkuan a makaih siampi lian khat a nei i hih nungsang,

upna hangin telcianna tawh a kidim lungsim a maantak tawh ahi zongin, kitheihtawmna lungsim a hoihlo pan a siang dingin tui a kitheh i lungtangte leh tui siang sunga kisawp i pumpite tawh ahi zongin, a kiang va nai ni.
Kamciam hong piapa muanhuai ahih manin i pulak lametna thu, hoi lo-in lenkip ni.
Itna leh nahoih sepna lamah khatlekhat kisatsuahzia ding lungngai ni.
Mi kimkhatte' tatzia bangin kikhop i tawpsan kei ding a, tua Ni hong nai ta cih thei na hih mah bangun khatlekhat kihanthawn semsemzaw ni.
A hang pen thumaan thutak theihna cingtaak i ngah khit nungah thei pipi-in mawhna bawl suaksuak lehang mawhphel nading biakpiakna dang om nawnlo hi.
Launa linna tawh thukhenna ngak ding cih thu leh galte a kangtum ding meikuang lianpi khat cih bek om lai hi.
Moses' thukhun a nawlkhin peuhmah teci nihlethum a om leh thukhualna kizang lo-in sihna kithuaksak hi.

Pasian' Tapa a simmawhbawl mi, amah a kisiansakna ahi thuciamna sisan a sianglo a bangsak mi, hehpihna Kha nakpi-in a hehsak mi, hih bang mi tawh a kituak gawtna pen bangzahtak suksiazaw ding cih na ngaihsunkha uh hiam?
A hang pen eite in, “Phulakna keima' a hi a, keimah'n ka thukkik ding hi,” a cipa i thei hi. Tua banah, “Topa in a mite' tungah thukhen ding hi,” cih hi lai hi.
A nungta Pasian' khutsung i va pukkhak ding pen a lauhuai thu ahi hi.
Ahi zongin lungvakna na ngah khit uh, gimthuaknate tawh nakpi kinawkna na tuahkhak uh, a beisa hunte phawkkik un.
Khatveivei milak ah simmawhna leh gimpiakna na thuakkha uh a, khatveivei tua bang a thuakkhate na kithuahpih uh hi.
A hang pen thongkiate na lainatpih uh a, neihlelam a hoihzaw leh a kipzaw khat na neihlam uh nomaumah kitel na hih manun na neihsa uh hong kisuhkhiatsak ciangin zong lungdamtak na sangsiam lel uh hi.
Tua ahih manin pahtakman lianpi a ngah ding ahi na sunglam kimuanna uh khahsuahkha kei un.
A hang pen Pasian' deihna na sep zawh nadingun leh hong kikamciam thu na ngah nadingun thuakzawhna na kisam uh hi.
A hang pen, “Tomnokal sungin a hong pai dingpa hong tung ding a, hong ziakai lo ding hi.
Ahih hangin ka midik ahihleh upna tawh nungta ding a, amah tonkik bang hileh ama' sungah ka nunna kha in lungkimna ngah lo ding hi.”
Ahi zongin eite i hihleh siatna a tuakkha dingin a tonkik namte i hikei a, eima' nunna kha a hu a kem dingin upna a nei namte i hizaw hi.
